about: 45 product-photo presets for image-product-presets. Each prompt is SL8's restatement of a Higgsfield preset recipe (2026-10-11 capture): same structure and instructions, our wording. Send `prompt` unchanged as the edit model's prompt.

opening.commercial: Produce a refined commercial still of the product, using the attached photo as the definitive reference for its appearance.
opening.marketing: Produce a production-grade marketing still of the product, using the attached photo as the definitive reference for its appearance.

opening.conceptual: Produce a premium conceptual still of the product, using the attached photo as the definitive reference for its appearance.

shared.tilt: If the source photo was shot with the camera tilted or from above, do not carry that viewpoint over; set the product straight, frame it neatly and level, and orient it the way this shot would naturally show it.

preserve.label: Keep the product exactly as supplied: its identity, outline, proportions, materials, colors, logo position, packaging construction, and legible label text.
preserve.source: Keep the product exactly as supplied: its identity, outline, proportions, materials, colors, logo position, packaging construction, and legible text from the source.

shared.text_fidelity_extended: Reproduce all printed matter just as the reference shows it, including stickers, small print, and minor marks; do not make up, translate, or swap any word or character, and draw any glyph you cannot read as a faithful shape.
shared.text_guard_pair: Write no slogans, taglines, or claims of taste, quality, emotion, or health, and no comparisons with other products; the only product words allowed are those visible in the reference. Invent no phone numbers, addresses, URLs, QR codes, or other contact details.

tail.A: Any people or hands shown must have natural anatomy and a believable product scale. Add no unsubstantiated claims, prices, additional logos, watermarks, or irrelevant products. The result should be a photorealistic, production-grade image with crisp edges and consistent shadows.
tail.B: Any people or hands shown need natural anatomy, a plausible grip, and true scale. Light the scene consistently and keep contact shadows physically believable. Fabricate no prices, ingredients, measurements, certifications, or factual claims, and add no additional logos, watermarks, or irrelevant products.
tail.C: Any typography must be brief, spelled correctly, and visually secondary to the product. Fabricate no product claims, endorsements, statistics, certifications, ingredients, or prices, and add no outside logos, watermarks, or additional products.
tail.D: Every effect must obey real physics, with perspective, lighting, reflections, and contact shadows that agree. Do not warp the product, create accidental copies of it, add unsubstantiated claims, bring in outside logos, or apply watermarks.

presets.title: Angles
presets.visible_effect: Several views of the product together in a single frame.
presets.prompt: Produce a refined commercial still of the product, using the attached photo as the definitive reference for its appearance. Show this one product from several viewpoints laid out next to each other as a single tidy catalog sheet: a front view taken straight on, a three-quarter angle, a side profile, and, optionally, one from directly overhead, all sitting on one continuous studio surface in front of a gently graduated backdrop. Space the views evenly at a matching scale and light them with the same soft, even studio light so each one is equally clear, every view resting on its own soft, consistent shadow. Beyond that surface and backdrop, include no props, scenery, styling objects, captions, or labels. Where the reference hides a side, continue its visible design language faithfully and leave those faces plain; do not invent regulatory copy, barcodes, or claims. Hold the design, branding, and colors identical from view to view. If the source photo was shot with the camera tilted or from above, do not carry that viewpoint over; set the product straight, frame it neatly and level, and orient it the way this shot would naturally show it. Keep the product exactly as supplied: its identity, outline, proportions, materials, colors, logo position, packaging construction, and legible label text. Reproduce all printed matter just as the reference shows it, including stickers, small print, and minor marks; do not make up, translate, or swap any word or character, and draw any glyph you cannot read as a faithful shape. Any people or hands shown must have natural anatomy and a believable product scale. Add no unsubstantiated claims, prices, additional logos, watermarks, or irrelevant products. The result should be a photorealistic, production-grade image with crisp edges and consistent shadows.
